## What’s new
- Two-Mac daily review: simultaneous work for different clients or projects on different Macs is kept as separate parallel work. Only the same work seen from both Macs (for example, driving a Mac mini thread from T3 Code or Screen Sharing on the MacBook) is counted once.

## What’s new
- Two Macs, one daily review: Settings › Capture › This Mac now has a Role. Set a second Mac to Capture only and it keeps capturing, publishes its app activity, Codex/T3, and Arc evidence for that day, and never runs reviews or sends to client apps. Your Reviewer Mac includes that evidence, labelled with the Mac's name, in the daily review. - The daily review won't run on an incomplete day: if a Capture-only Mac hasn't published, a review is blocked with a clear message and an explicit "Analyze without" option. - Screen Sharing time that overlaps the other Mac's work is no longer counted twice.

## What’s new
- Companies › Connections: link a company to an existing QuickBooks customer or vendor. Search QuickBooks, pick the record, and change or unlink it later. Beacon only saves the link; QuickBooks isn't changed. - QuickBooks Bills for a payee paid through their company now use the payee's established QuickBooks vendor when the company has no vendor linked, instead of failing. - Sign in with Passwords: if no Beacon login is saved, the button now says so instead of doing nothing, and Beacon offers to save your login to Passwords after you sign in with your email and password. - Banking: match transactions to invoices and payables, pair transfers (including loan accounts), split transactions, record statement balances, categorize many at once, review suggestions, and import QuickBooks checking CSVs. - Payroll: fixed-salary setup with a quarterly Form 941 screen and filled IRS PDF.

## What’s new
- Press ⌘K to search Beacon: type an amount (like 2458.75 or $1,710), an invoice or payable number (#405), a company, contact, or transaction, and open it straight away. "Search all records" (⌘↩) looks through older history too. - Quick jumps from ⌘K: overdue or open invoices, payables ready to pay, Banking › To review, or a company's open invoices — type "powertek overdue" to go right there. - Banking: new Loan proceeds, Loan repayment, and Loan interest & fees categories. Only a repayment's interest counts as an expense. - Fixed: typing J or K in the Edit proposal box no longer gets swallowed and moves the list behind it.

## What’s new
- Category dropdowns in Banking open faster, right inside the window. - New Rules view in Banking: see what Beacon remembered and which transactions each rule categorized. Change a rule's category — for future transactions only, or past ones too — or remove it and send its transactions back to To review. - Subscriptions now include usage-based services like Google Cloud, shown at their recent average.

## What’s new
- Banking has one Transactions section with three tabs: To review, All, and Subscriptions. - To review is built for speed: pick a category, see the check, move on. Add a note right in the row. - New Subscriptions tab: Beacon finds monthly and yearly charges and totals them. Use the switch to confirm one or mark it cancelled — Beacon flags any charge after you cancel. - New Card rewards & cash back category; card statement credits are recognized automatically. - Banking shows what's owed back to the business for personal charges, netting out refunds and paybacks.

## What’s new
- Category dropdowns in Banking open instantly, right under the field, ready to type into. - When you pick a category in To review, the row shows a green check with your choice (and whether Beacon will remember it) before it moves away. - Messages at the top of Banking clear themselves after a few seconds. - Fixed a leftover “90 days” notice that kept the SimpleFIN connection flagged.

## What’s new
- Search any category list in Banking: start typing ("food", "gas", "software") and press Return. Works in To review, the transactions table, transaction details, and the category filter. - Change a transaction's category right in the Banking table. - A cleaner Accounts window: cards and bank accounts grouped with totals, options tucked into a ⋯ menu, and a simple Add account step. - Banking windows close when you click outside them. - Spending by category now shows each category's share and what's still uncategorized. - Updates now install the newest version in one step.

## What’s new
- New Banking tab: see your business bank and card activity in one place — cash, card balances, money in, and spending by category, compared with last month. Read-only: Beacon never moves money. - Connect cards and banks (Amex, Chase, and most US banks) through SimpleFIN Bridge in Banking › Accounts; Beacon checks once each morning, or tap Sync now. Mercury can be connected with a read-only token. - Import downloaded statements (CSV, QFX, or OFX) for accounts no feed can reach, like QuickBooks Checking. Re-importing overlapping dates never creates duplicates. - Transactions categorize themselves: deposits and contractor payments are matched to payments already in Beacon, common merchants are recognized, and anything else waits in a short To review list. Your choices become rules for next time. - Export a year of categorized transactions as a CSV for your accountant. - Billing and profit reports now update with far less work behind the scenes.

## What’s new
- Add time for a subcontractor from the normal New Log form: pick them in the new Resource menu (it defaults to you). - Mac notifications for invoice drafts to review, automatic transfers to confirm, overdue invoices, payables due, and timers running long. Turn each on or off — and set how long counts as “long” — in Settings › Notifications. - Cash Flow shows the next 8 weeks of money in and out, with a running total. - Reports › Profit shows profit and margin by client and project for any period. - Finance numbers refresh when something changes instead of every 15 minutes, which keeps Beacon lighter.
